page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.c6a.16xlarge is a compute-optimized virtual server instance powered by the KVM hypervisor. It features 64 dedicated vCPUs mapped to 32 physical cores of an AMD EPYC 7H12 processor running at 2.6 GHz. The instance is equipped with 128.0 GB of system memory, providing a 2.0 GB per core ratio. It does not include local storage or dedicated GPU hardware, relying entirely on network-attached storage and offering a baseline network bandwidth of 16 Gbps.

Performance benchmarks indicate a clear distinction between single-threaded and multi-threaded capabilities. While single-core performance is relatively weak, as shown by stress-ng single-core CPU performance in the bottom 10% and weak single-threaded gzip compression, the instance excels in highly parallel tasks. Multi-threaded bzip3 decompression, Geekbench ray tracing, PassMark CPU score, and PassMark CPU encryption tests all rank in the top 25%. Memory bandwidth and database operations consistently perform in the middle 50%.

This hardware profile offers high resource density for parallelized workloads, making it a cost-efficient option for multi-threaded processing without the overhead of local storage or GPU accelerators. The dedicated CPU allocation ensures consistent performance for workloads such as software compilation, multi-threaded data decompression, web serving, and parallelized CPU-bound tasks.
